title: ChangeEvent candidate (the stored raw of one catalog instrument changed between two retrievals)
description: RG side of the Goodware canon ChangeEvent (PREZIP_DESIGN_CLOSED_SOURCE.md §24). Emitted when the sha256 of a catalog entry's raw changes from before_ref to after_ref. Every field is copied from the catalog or verbatim from the official text; nothing is inferred. status is always CANDIDATE. There is no semantic_delta: what the change means is reasoning and belongs to ZPMND, so the field does not exist here and is rejected like any unknown field. Checks a schema cannot express live in rg.schemas: before_ref differs from after_ref, provenance.sha256 and effective_at_evidence.raw_sha256 are after_ref, entry_id belongs to source_id.

before_ref.description: sha256 of the previous stored raw version (catalog versions[]).

after_ref.description: sha256 of the new stored raw version (catalog versions[]).

published_at.description: Official publication date of the new text as the source prints it (catalog dates.published or dates.last_reform_printed). null when the source prints none; never the retrieval date, never inferred.

effective_at.description: Entry into force, only when a transitorio article prints the calendar date; effective_at_evidence then carries that article's quote. Otherwise null: a relative rule such as 'al día siguiente de su publicación' is not turned into a date here.
